title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract — Payment Posting and Application Terms
content:
**Payment terms of the Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

(a) A payment can be posted only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or in deficiency. This is read from the contract's status in the company's records.

(b) *No longer in force:* "A payment received before the payment cutoff time Central Time on a business day posts that day; a payment received later, or on a weekend or US federal holiday, posts the next business day." This clause is no longer in force as written and has been superseded by the current posting terms of the contract.

(c) Each payment is applied in the payment allocation order: first to simple interest accrued over the interest accrual days at the contract APR on a year of the day-basis length for the tier, then to principal until the installments due are satisfied, then to fees due, and any remainder to principal. The interest accrual days are the calendar days from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the payment posting date, both inclusive. The installments due are the past-due amount plus the monthly payment of the installment due on the next due date when that date falls within one month after the posting date; that is the amount a payment must reach before any part of it goes to fees.

(d) Because interest is satisfied first and fees last, an installment paid in full within its grace period is never treated as late merely because an earlier fee remains unpaid.

(e) A payment designated principal-only is accepted only when the days past due are 0 and is applied to principal after accrued interest is satisfied; it never advances the next due date. Payments in excess of the installment reduce principal and do not advance the next due date unless the customer pays a full additional installment.

(f) The channel fee in the convenience fee schedule is collected on top of the payment as a convenience fee and is never applied to the contract; the agent-assisted debit card fee is not charged when the payment is a reinstatement or redemption, which must be made in certified funds. Debit card payments are limited to the debit card payments allowed per calendar month and to the largest single debit card payment each.

(g) While the certified-funds-only date on the contract is on or after the posting date, only cashier's check, wire or MoneyGram payments are accepted.

(h) When a payment carries a fee portion, that portion is booked as a fee payment against fees due; enrolling or unenrolling autopay is recorded on the contract.

### Application of a payment (hypothetical)

Accrued interest $40.00, installments due $400.00, fees due $25.00, payment $450.00: interest takes $40.00; principal takes $360.00, bringing interest and principal to the $400.00 installments due; fees take $25.00; the remaining $25.00 goes to principal.

superseded_clauses: A payment received before payment_cutoff_time_ct Central Time on a business day posts that day; a payment received later, or on a weekend or US federal holiday, posts the next business day.
